# Human+ Qendra Diagnostike

> Diagnostic centre in Prishtina, Kosovo, since 2011. Laboratory (continuing the BAKTOLAB laboratory) with five modules: haematology, biochemistry, hormones, immunology, and microbiology including parasitology and mycology. Specialist services: paediatrics, gynaecology and endocrinology, with more specialties coming.

- Address: Rruga B, Nr. 16, 10000 Prishtina, Kosovo
- Phone: +383 44 709 072 · +383 48 750 150 · +383 38 750 150
- E-mail: info@humanplusks.com
- Hours: Mon–Fri 07:30–19:00, Sat 08:00–16:00, Sun closed
- Prices are given by reception (phone, WhatsApp, e-mail); they are not published on the site.
